verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an email-infrastructure API for provisioning new inboxes for AI agents, not a personal unified-inbox client for consolidating a switcher's existing Gmail/Microsoft 365/IMAP accounts. Its IMAP/SMTP support runs in the opposite direction — connecting external clients like Outlook or Thunderbird to an AgentMail-hosted inbox — rather than importing or aggregating a user's pre-existing multi-provider accounts, so this axis does not apply to the product's category.
